The native component compiles the actual production file-handle-owner.h and exercises real descriptor/OFD ownership and one native close thread. It does not compile or execute the SpiderMonkey FS fragments, work queue, clone packet or guest libc. The copied integer fd in those fragments remains observable metadata; FileHandleLease owns its close. Public FileHandle transfer remains disabled until the actual native clone sidecar/tag, receiver-local factory/admission/abort owner and target registry are integrated.
